title: Mara and the Inventory
author: Wren Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Yarrow, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
